certificates.title: Medical documents
certificates.lead: Sick leaves, medical reports and attendance certificates issued by the clinic. Each one carries a QR code to verify its authenticity.
certificates.panel_empty: No documents issued for this visit.
certificates.panel_hint: Sick leave, medical report or attendance certificate with a verification QR code.
certificates.no_national_id: No national ID on the patient's file.
certificates.leave_help: From the visit date, up to 7 days later. At most {max} days.
certificates.show_diagnosis: Print the diagnosis on the certificate
certificates.show_diagnosis_help: Off by default for the patient's privacy: the certificate then only says the patient was examined and advised rest.
certificates.companion_leave: The patient needs a companion (companion leave)
certificates.attachments_help: One per line, e.g. "Blood test of 12/09". Listed on the report; the files themselves are not attached.
certificates.prefilled: Prefilled from the visit note — review before issuing. The document cannot be edited once issued.
certificates.revoke_help: The verification page will show it as revoked. The document is kept for the record and cannot be deleted.
certificates.reissue_help: To correct a mistake, revoke this document and issue a new one prefilled with the same content.
certificates.empty_text: Doctors issue sick leaves, medical reports and attendance certificates from the visit page.
certificates.authenticity: Anyone holding the paper can check its authenticity by scanning the QR code.

doc.sick_body: This is to certify that {patient} was examined at {clinic} on {date} and was advised to rest for {days}, from {start} to {end} inclusive.
doc.sick_body_f: This is to certify that {patient} was examined at {clinic} on {date} and was advised to rest for {days}, from {start} to {end} inclusive.
doc.companion_body: The patient requires a companion during the same period: {name}.
doc.attendance_body: This is to certify that {patient} attended {clinic} on {date} from {from} to {to}.
doc.attendance_body_f: This is to certify that {patient} attended {clinic} on {date} from {from} to {to}.
doc.verify_text: Scan the code, or open {url} and enter the serial number and the code {code}
doc.revoked_banner: REVOKED — this document is no longer valid.

verify_doc.title: Verify a medical document
verify_doc.lead: Check that a sick leave, medical report or attendance certificate was issued by the clinic and is still valid.
verify_doc.form_help: Both are printed at the bottom of the document, next to the QR code.
verify_doc.valid_text: This document was issued by the clinic below and has not been revoked.
verify_doc.revoked_text: The clinic revoked this document on {date}. It is no longer valid.
verify_doc.not_found_text: Check the serial number and code and try again. A document that cannot be found here should not be relied on.
verify_doc.limited_text: Please wait a few minutes before checking again.
verify_doc.privacy: For privacy, the patient's name is partly hidden and no medical details are shown.
verify_doc.disclaimer: This page confirms the document's authenticity as recorded by the issuing clinic. Whether it is accepted is up to the receiving party; some countries require documents from their national platforms.

errors_certificates.VISIT_NOT_ATTENDED: Documents can be issued only for visits that took place.
errors_certificates.VISIT_IN_FUTURE: This visit has not taken place yet.
errors_certificates.NO_DOCTOR: Assign a doctor to this visit first.
